title: a little too far ＼(~o~)／
author: AaronH
rules:
think i'm taking the puns a little too far? me too.

congratulations to evan on the first month of sudokubank.

rules

• 6x6 sudoku: fill the grid with digits 1-6 so that no digit repeats in any row, column or 3×3 box.

there is a negative constraint in this puzzle.

• x sums: an x connects two digits that sum to 10. all xs are given.

• v sums: a v connects two digits that sum to 5. all vs are given.

• slow thermometer: along a grey thermometer, digits must not decrease when moving from the bulb to the tip.

• black dots: a black dot connects two digits where one is exactly double the other. not all dots are necessarily given.
